description: Change how fast an effect animates by spreading its keyframes further apart or closer together (scale) from the first or last keyframe, and optionally shifting them all (offset), keeping each keyframe's value and interpolation. Keyframes are one undo step, interpolation a second

anchor.description: The keyframe that stays put when scaling. Default first

clip.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

offset.description: Then move every keyframe by this many seconds. Default 0

param.description: Parameter name as list_clip_effects reports it, e.g. "Scale"

paramIndex.description: Parameter index instead of a name

scale.description: Spacing factor: 2 makes the animation take twice as long, 0.5 half as long. Default 1

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: retime_keyframes
title: Retime Keyframes
